title: Lacquered Crispy Ukrainian Vegetable Bowl
description: A charred and crispy Ukrainian dish featuring hoisin sauce and a lacquer glaze, served in a dolsot stone bowl, this lacto-vegetarian friendly meal is both energizing and delicious. It combines the freshness of vegetables with the depth of hoisin sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together hoisin sauce and lacquer glaze.
Add sliced carrots, zucchini, bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sauce-coated vegetables to the skillet and cook until they start to char.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and season the vegetables with salt and black pepper.
Serve the vegetables in a dolsot stone bowl.
Garnish with additional lacquer glaze if desired.
